An '''individual''' served as an [[Imperial weapons technician]] early during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]], and was stationed on [[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]'s [[Eriadu]] compound, [[Raven's Peak]]. The [[technician]] was an [[officer]], and was subordinate to [[Lieutenant]] [[Maylur]]. During the [[bombing of Raven's Peak]] concurrently undertaken by the [[Partisans]] and [[Clone Force 99]], the officer reported several malfunctions to Lieutenant Maylur. As an officer, the technician wore a light [[Color|gray]] tunic and technican's [[helmet]], as well as a [[rank insignia plaque]] with four red tiles denoting his rank.<ref name="The Summit" />
